title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E6 — Have Gun, Will Sell
Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E7 — The Dowry
Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E8 — Half A Brother
George's attempts to make points with a local banker are frustrated by Allan's attempts to make points with the banker's daughter.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E9 — What Are Friends For?
George agonizes over a decision that could change both his life and the life of someone very special. George's favorite cousin, Dusty, delights the Jeffersons with a surprise visit, but concerns them with some serious news.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E10 — George Who?
Louise insists that she and George have fallen into a rut, until a turn of fate transforms their 'routine' into the good old days.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E12 — George Finds A Father
George's Christmas is merrier after Louise's intervention helps him find a father he never knew.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E13 — Louise's Sister
A surprise for Louise turns into a shock for George after she has a strange reaction to a visit from her long-lost sister.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E14 — Louise's Reunion
When Louise finds out about a new clause in George's will, she almost gives him cause to use it.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E7 — The Smothers Brothers, Melba Moore
Flips intros his invisible dog; a traveling salesman hits on Melba in the old days and the Smothers Bros join Rev. Leroy’s church.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E9 — Dom DeLuise, Diahann Carroll, Kermit The Frog, The Muppets
Flip jokes about ugly fans; Diahann kisses Kermit; a drunk muppet has hiccups and Diahann stops by Flip’s gas station.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E10 — Tim Conway, Andy Griffith, The Clara Ward Singers
Flip & Andy are firemen; Tim sells luxury cars; Andy does his famous Romeo And Juliet monologue and Rev. Leroy preaches.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E12 — Tony Randall, Phyllis Diller, Billy Eckstine
Flip & Tony do a kiddie TV show; Phyllis Diller does stand-up in an outrageous outfit and Geraldine works at a boutique.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E14 — Belafonte/Nelson/Poitier
Sidney Poitier and Harry Belafonte discuss their new film, Buck and the Preacher, as well as other topics, interrupted by interludes of song by Novella Nelson.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E15 — Ruby Dee/Ossie Davis
Ruby Dee and Ossie Davis, aided by the music of composer-saxophonist Lucky Thompson, give dramatic readings of the poetry of a writer named Robert Cornell Kaufman.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E4 — Consulting Adults
Webster tries out for the football team. Katherine is then afraid that Webster will get seriously hurt especially because of his height and build. Also, we learn that Webster is picked to be on the team only because of George's fame in football.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E5 — Travis
It is revealed to George and Katherine why Travis, Webster's late father, chose George to be Webster's godparents and legal guardians if something happened to them.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E9 — Don't Jump George
Katherine is too obsessed with winning when she appears on a game show.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E10 — A Question of Honor
All the blame goes to Webster when his friends try to rob the Tracadero, their hangout.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E12 — Educating Katherine
Katherine gets a taste of the worst: being a volunteer art teacher. She feels that she is boring and failing, so Webster tries to help her.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E1 — Designer Genes
Tia and Tamera slip backstage at a red-hot fashion show.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E2 — A Separate Peace
Fed up with sharing the same bedroom, the twins are torn between getting their own rooms.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E3 — Working Girls
Ray's budding relationship with a new woman leaves Tamera feeling jealous.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E4 — Show Me the Money
When Tamera learns that Tia is being paid less than a male co-worker, she poses as Tia.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E5 — It's My Party
The twins sneak to Chicago to celebrate their 17th birthday.

title: Moesha

S6 E17 — Scary Marriage
Moesha and her friends are matched up in a mock marriage for a homework assignment.
